facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics downloads page lists The 2024 Gambia Statistical Abstract, a Transport Statistics Summary Report 2025 and International Merchandise Trade Statistics 2015 to 2025 for download.
The Gambia Bureau of Statistics lists the Gambia Labour Force Survey GLFS 2026 (Q1), alongside the 2019/20 DHS, MICS6 and IHS 2020, with reports and microdata for download.

GMB.note: Only an economic census is listed; no population census stated.
No ICT employment share or youth unemployment figure stated.

facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics publishes GDP, CPI, PPI, trade and survey reports with microdata for download at gbosdata.org/downloads; no licence is stated.
